Very interesting. Unfortunately I don't think I have any giant eagle costumes in stock at the moment.
Well, feel free to come back if you change your mind.
Well, the main problem is that I'm fresh out of giant eagle feathers. I've been meaning to get onto my supplier about that for some time.

A few weeks ago we had a delivery of a northern ferret. They're funny little creatures. Turns out they're tricksy little blighters too.
Actually, now that you come to mention it, you might be able to help me.
Ah, hello again. Have you had any luck finding a clue as to Nickolaus' whereabouts yet?

Like I said, he's most likely to be camping out somewhere to the west of the Gnome Stronghold.
No, I could do with some help, but I'm afraid I need somebody with a little more experience.
Oh well, I'm sure he'll be okay out there on his own.
This was obviously a bit of a blow, you can't make a new attraction without any animals.
We got in contact with one of our associates, a huntsman called Nickolaus, who agreed to capture us another.
Well the northern ferret is mostly found around the mountains just west of the Gnome Stronghold, so that would probably be as good a place as any to start looking.
Well... maybe. How much do you know about hunting?
Whilst we were unloading him from the cart he managed to escape his cage. What's more he gave the driver a nasty nip on the way out too.
Yes, er, welcome to the zoo! I'm afraid I'm kind of busy right now; what was it you wanted?
You do? Ah, yes, wonderful, I never doubted you for a second. That'll make an excellent addition to the zoo.
Actually I believe you could. I need to somehow trick the eagles into thinking I'm one of them. Could you fashion some sort of disguise for me?
Ah wonderfully. They're actually most cooperative creatures once they get used to you. With some rope I'm sure you could find some way to tame them... maybe even fly on them.
Ah yes, he sent me to find a ferret. A trivial task, and one which pales in comparison compared to this momentous discovery. I'm sure he can wait.
Ah you don't get out of it that easily. When you've got the time come back and see me.

Very true, and certainly an opportunity I wouldn't want to miss.
Well bring it over here then. It's not much use to me over there.
Well I think trapped is quite a negative way of looking at it.
